title: Decide the supported scope for partial capos
scope: Determine whether per-string capo data belongs in the Guitar Pro parity target given the documented AlphaTab limitation.
acceptance: Inspect a valid partial-capo Guitar Pro file and record what the pinned importer retains or loses.
Identify whether independent consumer validation is available for any subset.
Record a justified scope decision; if supported scope expands, specify a concrete follow-up and oracle before implementation.
exclusions: Do not count an AlphaTab-unsupported feature as an existing parity defect by default.

reproduction.instructions: Inspect a valid partial-capo Guitar Pro file and record what the pinned importer retains or loses.

evidence.detail: needs-evidence: Partial-capo properties exist, but nonzero fixture semantics, string-flag order and a retaining oracle are missing.

The next required artifact is a Guitar Pro fixture with a nonzero partial capo fret and asymmetric string flags, plus a consumer that retains those values. Use it to establish flag/string order, pitch effects and interaction with whole-staff capo. Pinned AlphaTab currently discards the properties, so its default output cannot validate the semantics. Once those facts are known, create a bounded mapping/API contract linked to #43. Until then keep the unsupported status explicit; do not infer the flags from tuning or collapse them into the whole-staff capo.
